newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE option traffic high ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE option traffic high ahead of expiry.

text.p: Options business on Thursday was at higher than usual levels on the eve of Friday's monthly expirations as retail and professional investors jockeyed for position, taking opposing views on the strength of shares.
Dealers said retail players had built up big positions in November 600 calls a few weeks ago, betting on the AEX index staying at or above 600 at tomorrow's expiration.

"A lot of market makers have the opposite view and they're sitting on positions where they could get hurt if that happens, so you can expect them to try again to get the index back below the 600 level tomorrow," said one trader.

"The only thing that the market makers really need is a weaker Dow Jones close tonight and that could be enough to tip the AEX lower tomorrow," he said. In late Amsterdam trading Wall Street was showing a six point decline, opening lower after eight days on the upside.
Total options volume at 1515 GMT was 152,230 contracts, well above the 100,000 or so daily average and the 120,000 contract level usually seen the day before an expiration.
Dealers said with 28,030 AEX index calls and 15,010 puts traded for 28.25 percent of total turnover there were signs that retail investors were selling out and banking profits.

In late Thursday trading the AEX share index was 2.70 points higher at 604.72, a whisker away from the 604.76 all-time high reached earlier in the session and on course to beat Wednesday's 602.02 closing record high.
Dealers said many of the November 600 calls had been taken out when the AEX was around 580. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
